project.name: Focus Contract Studio
project.summary: A WebMCP-native, human-governed studio that preserves dialog-focus decisions as revisioned precedent, stages unapplied proposals, binds approval to an exact revision, and verifies the resulting live behavior.
project.ai_usage: ChatGPT reasons over page-bound WebMCP tools; the application uses no model API. D1-backed RRF retrieves scoped precedent but never authorizes mutation.
project.codex_usage: Codex supported official-source research, product design, implementation, test-driven repairs, security and adversarial review, release preparation, and repository documentation. Exact R11 source-to-Sites deployment evidence and screenshots are attached to the public R11 GitHub release; exact supported-client traces for the unchanged four-tool contract remain attached to R10. The live Devpost draft is complete except for the entrant's country-of-residence answer, required video, and final submission.
